summary: AAP 2.6 RPM base requirements: a valid subscription, RHEL 9.4 or later 9.x, x86_64, AArch64, s390x or ppc64le, ansible-core 2.16+, current Firefox or Chrome, PostgreSQL 15 for managed databases or 15, 16 or 17 external (needs ICU; 16 and 17 need external backup), and IPv4/IPv6 single or dual stack. A resilient deployment needs 10 VMs with 16 GB RAM and 4 vCPU.
questions: Which RHEL versions does AAP 2.6 RPM support?
Which PostgreSQL versions does AAP 2.6 support?
Can I use PostgreSQL 17 with AAP?
How many VMs does a resilient AAP deployment need?

answer_card.title: AAP 2.6 base requirements (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| OS | RHEL 9.4 or later 9.x |
| CPU | x86_64, AArch64, s390x, ppc64le |
| ansible-core | 2.16+ |
| Managed DB | PostgreSQL 15 |
| External DB | PostgreSQL 15, 16, 17 (ICU; 16/17 need external backup) |
| IP | IPv4, IPv6, dual-stack |

Resilient deployment: 10 VMs, each 16 GB RAM, 4 vCPU.
